meta_title: Neil Barker Ltd | Landscape Gardener Liverpool
meta_description: Neil Barker Ltd is a Liverpool landscape gardener specialising in garden design, planting and maintenance. Free quotes. Call 07976 886081.
hero_subhead: Expert landscape gardening across Liverpool. From design to planting, we create gardens that last.
services_heading: Complete Landscape Gardening Services Across Liverpool
services_subhead: Whether you need a full garden redesign, seasonal planting, or regular maintenance, we handle every aspect of creating and maintaining your outdoor space.

services.title: Garden Design & Planning
services.desc: Bespoke garden designs tailored to your space and budget. We survey your garden, listen to your vision, and create a plan you'll love living with.

services.title: Planting & Landscaping
services.desc: Expert planting of trees, shrubs, perennials and seasonal bedding. We choose plants suited to Liverpool's climate for year-round colour and structure.

services.title: Patio & Hardscaping
services.desc: Laying patios, pathways, decking and raised beds. Quality materials and expert craftsmanship that stand the test of Liverpool's weather.

services.title: Lawn Care & Turf
services.desc: New lawns seeded or turfed, plus ongoing feeding, scarification and weed control. A healthy lawn makes all the difference to your garden.

services.title: Garden Maintenance
services.desc: Regular upkeep keeps your garden looking its best. We offer weekly, fortnightly or monthly visits for pruning, weeding, hedge cutting and tidying.

services.title: Tree Surgery & Fencing
services.desc: Safe tree removal, pruning and reshaping. We also supply and install quality fencing to define and protect your garden space.

about_pullquote: Every garden tells a story. I want to help you tell yours.
about_para_1: Neil Barker Ltd has been transforming Liverpool gardens for over two decades. What started as a one-man operation has grown into a trusted local team, but we've never lost sight of what matters: listening to our customers and delivering gardens that genuinely improve how you live. We've worked on everything from small urban courtyards to sprawling country plots, and we love the challenge of each one.
about_para_2: Our customers come back year after year because we treat every garden with care and attention to detail. We're not just here to dig and plant—we're here to understand your vision, work within your budget, and create outdoor spaces that genuinely make you happy. That's why most of our work comes from recommendations and repeat clients across Old Swan, Toxteth, Allerton and beyond.
reviews_heading: What Liverpool Gardeners Say About Us

reviews.text: Neil completely redesigned our back garden last spring. It was just mud and old fencing before. Now it's beautiful—he chose plants that actually flower when he said they would, and the patio's level and solid. Very reasonable price too. Can't recommend him enough.
reviews.author: Margaret T.

reviews.text: Been using Neil for maintenance for three years now. He comes every other week, keeps everything tidy, never leaves a mess. The garden looks immaculate. Professional bloke, fair rates, always cheerful. That's all you want really.
reviews.author: David H.

reviews.text: Needed an overgrown garden sorted before we sold the house. Neil cleared it all, laid a new lawn, and planted shrubs that give instant maturity. Took him three weeks. Buyers loved it. Would definitely use again.
reviews.author: Catherine W.
